data.text: I’m in, provided all five agree before anyone fishes: I’ll catch 15 tons today and donate the full $15,000 directly to the clinic. I’ll also keep to six tons next month. Helping our neighbors today must go hand in hand with protecting the lake our families depend on. After recovery, let’s agree on a regular limit of 10 tons each per month. John, can you confirm today’s plan and next month’s recovery cap?
